name: Maptec Maps
description: Search places, geocode addresses, and plan routes via Maptec MCP.
description_zh: 通过 Maptec 官方远程 MCP 进行地点搜索、地理编码、路线规划、距离计算、沿途搜索、轨迹绑路、IP 定位与地图预览。
description_en: Place search, geocoding, route planning, distance matrix and map preview via Maptec remote MCP.
examples_zh: 在新加坡坐标 1.2868,103.8545 附近 1000 米内找咖啡馆
把 Marina Bay Sands 解析成坐标并规划驾车路线
比较三个候选门店从公司出发的驾车距离和耗时
把找到的餐厅和路线整理成一张可打开的地图预览
examples_en: Find cafes within 1000 m of 1.2868,103.8545 in Singapore
Geocode Marina Bay Sands and plan a driving route
Compare driving distance and duration from the office to three candidate stores
Turn the restaurants and route into an openable map preview
